triggers: any spoken instruction, question, article, copula, yes/no word, or sentence form appears
any mismatch lacks an explicit visible wrong label and unique replacement
Any story page is missing, out of order, visually contradictory, or paired with the wrong caption.
Any story-interface worked example or scored answer does not match the centered active card.
Any asset hash, exact pixel review, or required control is unavailable.

finish.eligibility: All four controlled gates pass under gate_execution, mixed reaches 26 of 32, every story page is emitted, all story-backed checks pass, all post-story transfer checks are recorded, and closing_recap reaches 6 of 8.

mixed_execution.stop_rule: Run all 32 frozen mixed items once, then evaluate 26-of-32 before any TRAIN_LONGER release.

story_arc.initial_state_or_goal: At the start, exactly one immutable picture card for each of cup, plate, spoon, bowl, fork, knife, glass, and napkin occupies the eight lower source slots in frozen left-to-right order; all eight upper destination slots are empty outlines. Every card contains the same reviewed photograph of its one object kind on every page.
story_arc.meaningful_development: Across exactly eight connected pages, the active card advances in frozen order cup, plate, spoon, bowl, fork, knife, glass, napkin. On page i, cards earlier than i are in their upper matching slots, cards later than i remain in their lower source slots, and exactly the active card i is visibly centered on the fixed path between its lower slot and matching upper slot (page 8 places napkin at the upper endpoint while retaining the path-centered transition state). No card is redrawn, replaced, duplicated, hidden, fused, or identity-shifted; the only visual state change is this one-card-at-a-time row transition.
story_arc.resolution_or_stopping_state: The final page resolves with exactly one unchanged card of each of the eight kinds in the eight upper slots, exactly eight empty outlined lower slots, and no card in the source row. The event stops there. No character, hand, owner, use, food, material, color category, social ritual, or spatial/matching/directional knowledge is established or scored.
